title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - BillFormat
description: A detailed description of the way in which a bill is presented. (TM Forum TMF666 Account Management 5.0.0, OpenAPI component BillFormat; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:BillFormat:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'BillFormat'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'BillFormat' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name
